title: Analysts reset Intel stock price target ahead of earnings
text: Intel (INTC) stock has gained about 26.27% year to date, at the time of writing, Saturday morning, Jan. 17, according to Yahoo Finance. Meanwhile, SPY is up 1.43% in the same period. What caused Intel stock to outpace the S&P 500 by almost 25%? Two significant analyst notes boosted the stock. ...
